messages:
hana: Quick sync request: I'm proposing a new audit-focused export workflow. Defaults: partner SIEM exports TTL 30d. Add an `export.auditor` role for read-only access to export audit events and KMS-decrypt correlation. Need RBAC PR + KMS policy + SIEM webhook spec. @pete @olga
pete: Why 30d? balance of forensics vs minimization. fine by me if we get strong audit trails and auto-enforce deletion.
olga: On RBAC: add `export.requester`, `export.approver`, `export.executor`, and `export.auditor`. Auditor can only read request + audit events (no unseal). Executor is a small svc allowlist. Approver toggles approved flag.
hana: KMS policy notes: require EncryptionContext.request_id and encryptionContext.request_approved=="true". Deny Decrypt when request.legal_hold=="true". Also require kms:GrantIsForExport custom context. Record kms:RequestId and CMK key version in export.audit metadata.
pete: Important: when we rotate CMK, exports encrypted with old key must still be unwrapped (Decrypt allowed) for existing approved requests until retention expiry. CMK rotation policy should include a key_version field in audit so we can trace which key was used.
olga: SIEM webhook: on KMS Decrypt (CloudTrail), emit `export.unseal` with fields: request_id, kms.RequestId, cmk_key_version, approver_id, executor_id, timestamp. Also emit `export.deleted` when TTL enforcer removes objects. Create a dedicated SIEM index `export.audit` for these events.
hana: TTL enforcer: scheduled job that runs daily, finds exports with retention_end <= now, performs lifecycle delete and emits `export.deleted` event with request_id, deleted_by=ttl-enforcer, deletion_time, and CMK key_version metadata. Ensure deletion is irreversible and audited.
pete: CLI / Correlation snippet for ops in PR:
```bash
# find KMS decrypts for a request in CloudTrail / SIEM
cloudtrail query "eventName=Decrypt AND requestParameters.encryptionContext.request_id=REQ-2026-9001" | jq '.events[] | {time: .eventTime, kmsRequestId: .responseElements.requestId, user: .userIdentity.arn}'
# correlate to export.audit index in SIEM
siem query "index=export.audit request_id=REQ-2026-9001 | table event, cmk_key_version, approver, executor, time"
```
olga: DLP flow: request form has `contains_sensitive` flag; if true, DLP pipeline runs and writes to quarantined bucket path. `export.executor` cannot upload external copies until DLP passed and approver re-approves. Quarantined objects get separate lifecycle (manual GC after retention or on approval).
legal-mike: Legal: 30d baseline OK for partner handbacks. For legal_hold set on a request: require two approvers (legal + security). While legal_hold active, TTL_enforcer must skip deletion. Release requires documented reason + approver IDs and is immutable in audit.
sec-ops-bot: ticket created SEC-2026-7770 - export-audit-ttl-enforcer-and-kms-correlation. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-7770 status: open
hana: Action items: 1) olga - open RBAC PR + allowlist for executor & auditor 2) pete - draft CMK policy + key rotation note and CloudTrail->SIEM mapping 3) legal-mike - legal_hold release checklist 4) hana - spec SIEM webhook schema + TTL enforcer behavior. Sync tomorrow 10:00. :thumbsup:
